name: pulsecrypto-backend
description: Market data gateway between Binance public streams and the PulseCrypto mobile app

scripts.dev:broadcast:local: cross-env APP_ENV=local tsx watch --tsconfig packages/broadcast/tsconfig.json packages/broadcast/src/index.ts
scripts.dev:broadcast:development: cross-env APP_ENV=development tsx watch --tsconfig packages/broadcast/tsconfig.json packages/broadcast/src/index.ts
scripts.dev:broadcast:uat: cross-env APP_ENV=uat tsx watch --tsconfig packages/broadcast/tsconfig.json packages/broadcast/src/index.ts
scripts.dev:broadcast:debug: cross-env DEBUG=true tsx watch --tsconfig packages/broadcast/tsconfig.json packages/broadcast/src/index.ts
scripts.dev:ingestion:development: cross-env APP_ENV=development tsx watch --tsconfig packages/ingestion/tsconfig.json packages/ingestion/src/index.ts
scripts.dev:ingestion:uat: cross-env APP_ENV=uat tsx watch --tsconfig packages/ingestion/tsconfig.json packages/ingestion/src/index.ts
scripts.dev:ingestion:debug: cross-env DEBUG=true tsx watch --tsconfig packages/ingestion/tsconfig.json packages/ingestion/src/index.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:ingestion && npm run build:broadcast
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:shared && npm run typecheck:ingestion && npm run typecheck:broadcast
scripts.docker:up:development:debug: docker compose -p pulsecrypto-development -f docker-compose.development.yml -f docker-compose.development.debug.yml up --build
